Their efforts include reviewing whether risk levels have remained the same, decreased, or increased.
These stakeholders are also responsible for using the report to ask questions, or even to challenge an organization’s compliance programs.
The results of the risk assessment, and feedback from senior management, have an impact on policies, procedures, systems, resources, staffing, and training.
